title: (RHBA-2019:2740) Update to Fuse Integration Services 2.0 Images
portal_summary:
This update addresses the Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE) issues listed in the following security advisories:
https://access.redhat.com/errata/RHSA-2019:2571-03
portal_synopsis: Update to Fuse Integration Services 2.0 Images
portal_product_filter: Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|3.10|x86_64

portal_solution:
This update consists of the following parts:
* Updated FIS 2.0 images (provided through the Red Hat container catalog)

These images are intended for use with the following components:
* JBoss Fuse version: JBoss Fuse 6.3.0 Roll Up 11 (build 630377)
* BOM version: 2.2.170.redhat-000032
* Fabric8 Maven plug-in version: 3.1.80.redhat-000032
* Archetype version: 2.2.195.redhat-000027
* Archetype Catalog URL:
https://maven.repository.redhat.com/ga/io/fabric8/archetypes/archetypes-catalog/2.2.195.redhat-000027/archetypes-catalog-2.2.195.redhat-000027-archetype-catalog.xml

Update your FIS deployments to use the updated FIS image.

For details on how to apply this update, see the patching instructions in "Fuse Integration Services 2.0 for OpenShift"
https://access.redhat.com/documentation/en-us/red_hat_jboss_fuse/6.3/html/fuse_integration_services_2.0_for_openshift/patching
